proposal.hypothesis: Using 128 threads per row holding 32 FP32 values, exp2 instead of exp, distinct max/sum scratch, and only four barriers reduces synchronization and transcendental cost versus the 256-thread incumbent.
One 256-thread group per row with 16 register-cached FP32 values per thread via half4 loads avoids re-reading input, while SIMD plus threadgroup reductions provide fast stable max and sum.
